tasks.title: Review and Enhance Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Review and enhance the mobile responsive design for the calculator application.

1. Read existing responsive CSS files:
   - src/components/Calculator.css (media queries, layout)
   - src/components/Display.css (display responsive behavior)
   - src/components/Button.css (button sizing)

2. Verify responsive breakpoints:
   - Mobile: < 480px
   - Tablet: 480px - 768px
   - Desktop: > 768px

3. Test responsive behavior:
   - Start dev server (npm run dev)
   - Take screenshots at multiple viewport sizes: 375x667 (iPhone SE), 414x896 (iPhone XR), 768x1024 (iPad)
   - Verify layout, button sizes, display readability
   - Stop dev server

4. Write/update responsive tests:
   - Update src/components/Calculator.test.tsx to test responsive behavior if not already present
   - Ensure tests validate mobile layout adapts correctly
   - Test that components render without breaking at different viewport sizes

5. Fix any issues found:
   - Adjust CSS if layout breaks on any viewport
   - Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44px on mobile
   - Verify text is readable at all sizes
   - Ensure no horizontal scrolling on mobile viewports
acceptance_criteria: Calculator layout works correctly on mobile (< 480px)
Calculator layout works correctly on tablet (480-768px)
Calculator layout works correctly on desktop (> 768px)
Touch targets are at least 44x44px on mobile
Display text is readable at all viewport sizes
No horizontal scrolling on mobile devices

tasks.title: Validate Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Validate that the mobile responsive design works correctly across all device sizes.

1. Run the test suite:
   - Execute: npm test
   - Verify all tests pass, including responsive tests

2. Visual validation:
   - Start dev server: npm run dev
   - Take screenshots at mobile viewports (375x667, 414x896)
   - Take screenshot at tablet viewport (768x1024)
   - Take screenshot at desktop viewport (1920x1080)
   - Verify layouts are correct at each size
   - Check for any overflow or layout breaking
   - Stop dev server

3. Validate acceptance criteria:
   - Mobile layout displays correctly without horizontal scrolling
   - Tablet layout is appropriate for medium screens
   - Desktop layout utilizes larger screen space
   - Touch targets are appropriately sized on mobile
   - Text remains readable at all viewport sizes
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots show correct layout at all viewport sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop)
No layout breaking or overflow issues at any viewport size
Calculator is fully functional on mobile devices
